design_philosophy: A high-performance, function-first automotive parts e-commerce and auction platform. Inspired by the clarity of Swiss design and the urgency of live auctions, the UI focuses on legibility, technical precision, and high-contrast elements. The aesthetic relies on crisp typography, stark whites, deep charcoals, and sharp signal red accents to drive bidding actions.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards and buttons must have distinct hover states. Use translate-y-[-2px] for cards, and background color shifts for buttons.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: Scale down slightly (scale-95) on active/click for buttons.
motion_and_interactions.live_indicators: Use a subtle pulsing animation (animate-pulse) on the red dot of live auction badges.
motion_and_interactions.image_gallery: Use smooth zoom on hover for product gallery images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum WCAG AA standards. Grey text must be at least slate-600 on white.
accessibility.focus: Use explicit focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A0F1C] focus:ring-offset-2
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for search inputs, cart icons, and bidding buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='bid-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out a fully functional e-commerce frontend in React/Tailwind/Shadcn UI.
Create a persistent Header with a prominent search bar, cart icon with a badge, and user account link.
Below the Header, create a sticky Category Navigation bar with links: Engine, Brakes, Suspension, Electrical, Bodywork.
Build the Homepage: include a Hero Banner, a section for 'Live Auctions' with red timer badges, and grids for 'Featured Parts' and 'New Arrivals'.
Implement an Advanced Search component allowing filtering by brand, model, year, OEM reference, and condition.

Create a detailed Product Page featuring an image gallery (with thumbnails), technical description, vehicle compatibility table, and a dedicated section for bidding (showing current bid, input for new bid, and real-time countdown timer).
Implement a shopping cart slide-out or page, and a checkout flow UI.
Create a User Dashboard showing active bids, purchase history, and account settings.
Do NOT use pure border-radius on major containers (keep it sharp, rounded-none) to maintain the technical 'Swiss' look.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical icons.
Ensure the application strictly follows the light theme and high-contrast color palette provided.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements as per accessibility guidelines.
